title: Engenheiro De Ia Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro De Ia Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para assumir a manutenção e a evolução contínua do Plataforma Agents de IA — nosso framework de orquestração de agentes de IA que automatiza ciclos completos de desenvolvimento de software (refinement → dev →security → QA → deploy) em nossos projetos reais, em produção. Esta não é uma vaga de "treinar modelo" nem de "fazer prompt em chatbot". E engenharia de plataforma com foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção. O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter: - Orquestrador: Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara agentes (Claude/OpenIA/Gemini/DeepSeek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update.
- Agentes (@dev, @qa, @sec, @devops, @pm, @po, @sm, @analyst, @architect, @data-engineer, @ux-design-expert): cada um com persona, authority matrix definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade.
- Rules: Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent.
- Recovery loops: quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota.
- Multi-repo via submodules: projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar.
- Stack: Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.Js/TypeScript (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq, integrações com Jira/GitHub via curl + retry policy. O que você vai fazer Manutenção do core (40%)- Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade ciclomática.
- Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário.
- Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento.
- Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue).
- Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta "agent crashou em loop", "PR criado no repo errado", "deploy não promoveu") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva. Evolução de agents e rules (35%)- Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist).
- Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho.
- Manter o agent-authority.Md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex: @dev ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146).
- Criar/refatorar skills.
- Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B). Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%)- Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, OpenAI CLI, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek direct).
- Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex: DeepSeek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação).
- Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve.
- Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient;
expandir cobertura).
- Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection — entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria. O que esperamos de você Stack técnica — obrigatório - Bash/Shell avançado e Linux — você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs, parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.Sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de (( e porque importa.
- Node.Js / TypeScript — escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando não usar Node (ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS).
- Git e GitHub avançado — cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, GitHub Actions workflows.
- Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos — você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que "diga ao modelo o que não fazer" raramente funciona, entende o efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está "alucinando" um PR que não criou. Experiência - 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção.
- Pelo menos 1 ano com agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs em ambiente real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre "rodou no demo" e "rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano".
- Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer "reescrever do zero".
- Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios;
comunicação verbal podeser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time). Mentalidade - Determinismo >
magia. Você prefere umaregex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável.
- Forensics sobre intuição. Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese.
- Documentação executável. Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. "Documentei em texto" não basta.
- Empatia por agente. Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar. Diferenciais - Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes.
- Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker em integrações com APIs externas instáveis.
- Já trabalhou com monorepos via submodules (nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende os trade-offs.
- Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent frameworks).
- Experiencia com DevOps em servidores Linux dedicados (não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves.
- Familiaridade com conventional commits, semantic-release, gitflow trifásico (feature → homolog → main com cherry-pick).
- Já escreveu post-mortem público / case study técnico que outras pessoas referenciam. Benefícios - VR/VA – Flash Benefícios - Assistência Médica – Bradesco Saúde - Assistência Odontológica – Bradesco - Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4Life - Day Off de Aniversário - TotalPass - Parcerias educacionais (FIAP e Alura)

title: Bilingual Customer Service Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bilingual Customer Service Representative em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. ABOUT MASTERPRO MasterPro Installs is a U.S. appliance delivery and installation company operating in the U.S. We are an authorized installer for some of the largest retailers in the United States. Our trucks deliver and install refrigerators, ranges, dishwashers, and cooktops in customers' homes every day, and our remote team in Brazil is the voice our customers hear before and after every visit. THE ROLE You will be the direct line between MasterPro and our U.S. customers. You will confirm appointments, solve scheduling problems, follow up after installations, and make sure every customer interaction ends better than it started. You will work inside our CRM and operations systems all day;
everything you do getsdocumented, tracked, and measured. Our field teams are scored on customer surveys, and your work directly moves those scores. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Handle inbound and outbound customer contact by phone, SMS, and email: appointment confirmations, rescheduling, arrival windows, and post-installation follow-up.
- Work daily inside our CRM and operations platforms, keeping every customer record complete, accurate, and up to date — no exceptions.
- Coordinate in real time with U.S.-based dispatch and field teams to solve same-day problems: delays, access issues, product problems, and customer questions.
- Drive customer survey participation and satisfaction after every completed job — our teams are measured on surveys, and you own the follow-up that makes them happen.
- De-escalate frustrated customers with patience and professionalism, and turn complaints into resolved cases with documented outcomes.
- Flag recurring issues and process gaps to management — we promote problem-solvers, not ticket-closers. REQUIRED - Fluent, professional English — spoken and written. You will talk with American customers by phone all day. Interviews are conducted 100% in English.
- Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience with CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Monday.Com, or similar). You know how to live inside a CRM: logging, updating, searching, and following workflows.
- 100% remote readiness: reliable high-speed internet, a quiet professional workspace, a computer in good condition, and a quality headset.
- Availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours (afternoon/evening in Brazil). NICE TO HAVE - Experience serving U.S. or other international customers.
- Experience with Monday.Com, scheduling systems, or logistics/home-services operations.
- Spanish, in addition to English — many of our customers are bilingual. WHAT WE OFFER - 100% remote work from anywhere in Brazil, on a long-term engagement with a growing U.S. company.
- Compensation in line with experience, paid reliably every month.
- Real growth: our Brazil team members grow into finance, operations, and coordination roles as the company expands into new U.S. markets.
- Direct exposure to U.S. operations, tools, and standards — you will work with modern systems and real automation, not spreadsheets and improvisation. HOW TO APPLY Apply here on LinkedIn AND send your resume in English to with the subject line "Customer Service — Brazil". Include one short paragraph, in English, telling us about a difficult customer you turned around. Applications without the paragraph will not be reviewed — that paragraph is the first test.

title: Presales Solution Architect, Oss
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Presales Solution Architect, Oss em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Responsibilities: Act as the lead OSS solution architect across the full pre-sales lifecycle – from opportunity qualification and technical discovery through proof-of-concept, proposal, and contract award – partnering closely with Sales leadership to shape, qualify, and grow the regional pipeline. Own and orchestrate end-to-end responses to RFx (RFI / RFP / RFQ), including solution design, compliance and traceability matrices, win themes, technical narratives, effort and Bill-of-Materials estimation, assumptions, and risk identification – driving on-time, high-quality, fully compliant submissions. Design and articulate end-to-end OSS solution architectures spanning Service Assurance, Service Orchestration & Fulfilment, Inventory, and closed-loop automation, mapping the Rakuten Symphony portfolio to operator pain points and measurable business outcomes. Position and demonstrate the Service Assurance portfolio – fault, performance, and service-quality management;
AI/ML-driven anomaly detection, alarm correlation and noise reduction;
automated root-cause analysis;
and predictive, proactive assurance – including customer-experience and network-slice assurance for 5G Standalone. Develop solutions, value cases, and demonstrations around SMO (Service Management & Orchestration) and RIC (RAN Intelligent Controller) platforms, including the Non-RT RIC and rApps (R1, A1 interfaces) and the Near-RT RIC and xApps (E2 interface), addressing use cases such as RAN energy savings, traffic steering, QoE optimization, massive-MIMO and interference management, and anomaly detection. Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for customers. Lead technical proofs-of-concept, lab trials, product demonstrations, and solution integration and validation, tailoring demo environments to each customer's specific use cases, KPIs, and success criteria. Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand customer and third-party technical scrutiny. Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level. Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery / Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties – operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble winning and deliverable solutions. Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and webinars – and represent Rakuten Symphony at industry events and standards / community forums such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE. Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer conversations and internal strategy. Requirements: Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise: Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value. Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx responses and customer-facing technical engagements. Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault, performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management, and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance). Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5). Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management interfaces. Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment models. Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines, telemetry, and data lakes). Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal and external stakeholders. Willingness to travel as required.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms) Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: General Ledger Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para General Ledger Accountant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Midea Finance Shared Service Center (FSSC) is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented General Ledger Accountant to support our financial operations in Brazil. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing and accounting for customer receivables, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting. Key Responsibilities Perform compliance checks on general ledger transactions to ensure adherence to internal control standards and external financial regulations. Support month-end closing processes, including journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and account reconciliations. Review and validate financial postings and entries to ensure correct accounting treatment and timeliness. Identify and resolve system anomalies and data inconsistencies in the ERP system (e.G., Oracle / ibos) that impact financial reporting. Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all GL-related activities. Collaborate with internal and external auditors during financial reviews and audits. Work closely with cross-functional teams including Tax, FP&A, IT, and other finance departments to ensure smooth financial operations. Communicate in English with internal and external stakeholders regarding financial issues, documentation, and system problems. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in general ledger accounting, preferably in a shared service or multinational environment. Strong written and spoken English skills – required. Knowledge of Brazilian accounting and tax regulations is a plus. Proficient in ERP systems such as Oracle, or similar financial platforms. Familiarity with month-end closing, reconciliations, and journal entries. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a high level of attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills.

title: Direct Response Video Editor For 8-Figure Dtc Brand
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct Response Video Editor For 8-Figure Dtc Brand em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale. Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly. What You'll Actually Do High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously. Master Direct Response Mechanics: Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches) Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts) A/B test visual approaches based on performance data Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced. Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here. AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation. Top Fits Will Have: Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal) Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners) Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box) Bonus Points: Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes) Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools Portuguese + English fluency Non-Negotiables: Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions) Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment Obsessive attention to detail Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback Why Top Editors Choose Us: Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base. Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within. See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't). Professional Setup Access to premium stock libraries, SFX collections, motion graphics templates, and AI tools. We invest in your efficiency. Fully Remote + Flexible Work from anywhere with reliable internet. Core overlap hours with US Eastern Time for collaboration. High-Volume Learning Produce more ads in 6 months than most editors create in 2 years. Accelerate your skills exponentially. Application Process: Step 1: Submit Application Current CV/resume Portfolio link with 3-5 best DTC ads (Vimeo, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted) Brief note (3-4 sentences) explaining which ad in your portfolio performed best and why you think it worked Step 2: Paid Test Project ($100 USD) Top candidates receive raw footage + a creative brief to produce a 30-60 second Meta ad. Turnaround: 48 hours. Step 3: Interview + Strategy Discussion 30-minute video call to discuss your creative process, workflow, and alignment with our brand. Step 4: Onboarding Start with a 2-week paid trial producing live ads for our campaigns. Applications without portfolio samples will be not be considered. Good luck! We are excited to meet you!

title: Product Analyst - Vmake · Brazil
description:

Your understanding of short-form video trends, creator workflows, and AI-powered content creation will directly influence our product roadmap. Analyze user behavior, creator feedback, and product metrics to uncover opportunities for product improvements. Monitor trends across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, and emerging creator platforms, translating market insights into actionable product recommendations. Partner with Product Managers to define product requirements, prioritize enhancements, and support roadmap planning. Conduct competitive research on AI-powered creative tools and video editing platforms, identifying best practices and product gaps. Gather, organize, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative user feedback into clear product recommendations. Collaborate closely with Design and Engineering teams throughout feature discovery, testing, and iteration. Assist in defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance after launch. Create documentation including product briefs, user stories, competitive analyses, and feature specifications. Who You Are 3–5 years of experience in Product, Product Analysis, Product Operations, or a related product role within SaaS, AI, creator economy, social media, or e-commerce technology. Strong understanding of the Brazilian creator ecosystem and short-form video platforms. Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and enthusiasm for generative AI technologies. Experience translating customer pain points into clear product requirements. Strong analytical thinking with the ability to interpret both qualitative and quantitative data. Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Engineering. Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities. Preferred Qualifications Active content creator with a public portfolio or social media presence. Experience with TikTok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, or creator-focused commerce platforms. Experience conducting user interviews, usability testing, or product discovery. Familiarity with wireframing tools such as Figma. Experience using analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or similar platforms.

title: Head Of Finance- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head Of Finance- Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States. Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability. Position Overview VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Brazil to lead the financial strategy, governance, and regulatory reporting of the company's Brazilian VASP entity. Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business. The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership. Location Remote – Brazil Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities Financial Leadership Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity. Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives. Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards. Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership. Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports. Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations. Lead and oversee all regulatory financial reporting obligations, including COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad reporting (IN BCB 712/713), ensuring timely and accurate submissions to BACEN and other applicable regulatory authorities. Support VASP licensing requirements and ongoing regulatory reporting obligations. Coordinate external audits and manage relationships with auditors, the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), and other regulatory authorities. Maintain strong financial governance while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements. Treasury & Banking Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and banking relationships. Monitor financial performance, capital allocation, and funding requirements. Support payment operations, FX management, and cross-border transaction activities. Partner with Treasury and Operations teams to optimize financial infrastructure. Financial Controls & Risk Management Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance. Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements. Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership. Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership. Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning. Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals. Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field. CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred. MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus. 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions. Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership. Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements. Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred. Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Desired Competencies Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations. Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite. Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs. Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent. Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions. Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities. Why Join VelaFi? Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure. As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil, you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations. This is an opportunity to shape the financial future of a high-growth fintech company operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and cross-border payments. Equal Employment Opportunity VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Direct Response Video Editor For 8-Figure Dtc Brand

We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced. Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here. AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation. Top performers earn 20-30% above base. Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within. See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't). Professional Setup Access to premium stock libraries, SFX collections, motion graphics templates, and AI tools. We invest in your efficiency. Fully Remote + Flexible Work from anywhere with reliable internet. Core overlap hours with US Eastern Time for collaboration. High-Volume Learning Produce more ads in 6 months than most editors create in 2 years. Accelerate your skills exponentially. Application Process: Step 1: Submit Application Current CV/resume Portfolio link with 3-5 best DTC ads (Vimeo, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted) Brief note (3-4 sentences) explaining which ad in your portfolio performed best and why you think it worked Step 2: Paid Test Project ($100 USD) Top candidates receive raw footage + a creative brief to produce a 30-60 second Meta ad. Turnaround: 48 hours. Step 3: Interview + Strategy Discussion 30-minute video call to discuss your creative process, workflow, and alignment with our brand. Step 4: Onboarding Start with a 2-week paid trial producing live ads for our campaigns. Applications without portfolio samples will be not be considered. Good luck! We are excited to meet you!

Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States. Our operation is distributed by design across Brazil, the US and India. We have doubled our team in 2026 (now 30+) and will keep growing at a fast pace, with a People strategic plan already approved by the founders. For the first 12 months, this role will mix orchestration and execution: you will coordinate specialized recruiting agencies in the US, Brazil and India;
manage payroll and benefits;
design and manage development programs in direct partnership with the leadership across the world. One detail defines this role: your main internal clients are in the US and India. Interviews, trainings, sensitive career conversations and negotiations with American vendors will happen in English, every day. Compensation & Structure Full-time contractor (remote, based in Brazil) Fixed monthly compensation Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application What you'll do (major challenges for 2026) A. People Operations across 3 countries Map and stabilize payroll, benefits and employment flows in the US and India Work alongside a BPO in India on hires, payroll calendar, SLAs B. Training & Development Coordinate technical training programs across the US and India Design and coordinate a management development program that allows us to keep growing sustainably C. Recruiting (outsourced execution) Manage specialized recruiting agencies in search for technical positions Build scorecards with hiring managers and document the selection process, preparing the future internalization of recruiting (with new HR hire) Must-haves Fluent English (written and spoken) — a hard requirement. This is not English for occasional meetings: you will run interviews, facilitate trainings, handle sensitive conversations and negotiate with US search firms in English, daily 8-12 years of generalist HR experience Experience at coordinator-to-manager level Strong vendor management skills: BPOs, recruiting agencies, development consultancies Autonomy to operate without a ready-made structure and maturity to work directly with founders Availability to work across time zones: the India window falls in the Brazilian morning, and the US window in the afternoon Nice-to-haves Experience supporting internationally distributed teams Familiarity with the architecture, engineering or construction (AEC) industry Prior experience as a first HR hire or building a People function from scratch Selection Process 1. Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV 2. Screening: English and communication assessment (video)3. Technical challenge 4. Interviews with leadership 5. Offer Why join Downtown? Role with direct business impact Work directly with founders Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy High growth opportunity as the company scales PS: why Brazil? Our CEO is Brazilian and that's where most of our non-technical teams are based.

As we expand our Portuguese content library, we are looking for talented, professional Brazilian Voice Over Artists to join our global network of creators. You will collaborate remotely with our production, writing, and quality teams to deliver highly engaging, emotionally authentic performances for long-form series. This is a remote, contract-based freelance opportunity offering a consistent monthly pipeline of work for a long-term collaboration. Requirements Native Fluency: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with the ability to perform in Neutral Brazilian Portuguese. Versatility & Acting Chops: Strong acting, dubbing, or storytelling skills, with the ability to portray diverse characters across a wide range of ages and emotional profiles. Nice to Have Familiarity with basic audio editing and file management Experience working remotely with production teams Engagement Details Contract Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor Location: Remote (Work from your own studio) Compensation: Paid monthly on an hours delivered basis. How to Apply : Please fill in What happens after you apply? Our Casting & Production Process : Here is a look at our step-by-step collaboration pipeline: 1.Internal Evaluation: Our production team will carefully review your voice demos, studio specs, and portfolio to see if your vocal profile matches our upcoming projects. 2.Show Casting & Voice Testing: If your profile fits, we will invite you to a voice test for the specific audio series we are casting. This helps us ensure your performance aligns perfectly with the character's vision. 3.Contract & Legal Alignment: Once selected for a show, we will finalize a freelance legal agreement. This contract will clearly outline the voice usage rights for the series and formalize our agreed monthly payment terms. 4.Calibration & Onboarding: Before the official recording begins, we will run a brief calibration session. This ensures your studio's audio mastering levels match our technical delivery standards for a seamless workflow. 5.Production & Monthly Deliveries: Recording begins! Our long-form audio series typically span 150 to 300 hours in total. We partner with you for the long haul, expecting a steady delivery of 20 to 40 hours of recorded content per month until the series is complete.

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs. In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models. This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently. Key Responsibilities As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will: Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings. Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio. Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity. Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable. Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment. Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally. Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations. Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams. Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency. Required Language Proficiency Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role. Proficiency is required in: Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task) Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions) Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases) The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio. Required Experience The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas: PII identification or privacy annotation Risk assessment or content safety annotation Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling Named Entity Recognition or entity classification LLM response evaluation AI chatbot evaluation Policy-based content moderation Sensitive content classification Gen AI or LLM training data creation Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making. Skills and Competencies We are looking for candidates who have: Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language. Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills. A close attention to detail and consistency. Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately. Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content. Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech. Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup. Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking. Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams. Qualifications Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred. Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains. Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred. Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage. Engagement Terms This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side. Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down. Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary. Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept. What We Offer Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams. Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects. Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives. Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities. A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development. Application Note This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs. In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models. This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently. Key Responsibilities As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will: Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings. Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio. Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity. Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable. Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment. Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally. Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations. Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams. Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency. Required Language Proficiency Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role. Proficiency is required in: Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task) Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions) Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases) The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio. Required Experience The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas: PII identification or privacy annotation Risk assessment or content safety annotation Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling Named Entity Recognition or entity classification LLM response evaluation AI chatbot evaluation Policy-based content moderation Sensitive content classification Gen AI or LLM training data creation Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making. Skills and Competencies We are looking for candidates who have: Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language. Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills. A close attention to detail and consistency. Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately. Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content. Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech. Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup. Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking. Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams. Qualifications Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred. Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains. Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred. Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage. Engagement Terms This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side. Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down. Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary. Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept. What We Offer Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams. Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects. Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives. Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities. A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development. Application Note This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.

title: Engenheiro De Ia Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro De Ia Sênior em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para assumir a manutenção e a evolução contínua do Plataforma Agents de IA — nosso framework de orquestração de agentes de IA que automatiza ciclos completos de desenvolvimento de software (refinement → dev →security → QA → deploy) em nossos projetos reais, em produção. Esta não é uma vaga de "treinar modelo" nem de "fazer prompt em chatbot". E engenharia de plataforma com foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção. O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter: - Orquestrador: Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara agentes (Claude/OpenIA/Gemini/DeepSeek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update.
- Agentes (@dev, @qa, @sec, @devops, @pm, @po, @sm, @analyst, @architect, @data-engineer, @ux-design-expert): cada um com persona, authority matrix definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade.
- Rules: Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent.
- Recovery loops: quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota.
- Multi-repo via submodules: projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar.
- Stack: Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.Js/TypeScript (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq, integrações com Jira/GitHub via curl + retry policy. O que você vai fazer Manutenção do core (40%)- Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade ciclomática.
- Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário.
- Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento.
- Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue).
- Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta "agent crashou em loop", "PR criado no repo errado", "deploy não promoveu") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva. Evolução de agents e rules (35%)- Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist).
- Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho.
- Manter o agent-authority.Md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex: @dev ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146).
- Criar/refatorar skills.
- Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B). Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%)- Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, OpenAI CLI, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek direct).
- Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex: DeepSeek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação).
- Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve.
- Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient;
expandir cobertura).
- Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection — entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria. O que esperamos de você Stack técnica — obrigatório - Bash/Shell avançado e Linux — você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs, parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.Sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de (( e porque importa.
- Node.Js / TypeScript — escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando não usar Node (ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS).
- Git e GitHub avançado — cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, GitHub Actions workflows.
- Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos — você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que "diga ao modelo o que não fazer" raramente funciona, entende o efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está "alucinando" um PR que não criou. Experiência - 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção.
- Pelo menos 1 ano com agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs em ambiente real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre "rodou no demo" e "rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano".
- Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer "reescrever do zero".
- Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios;
comunicação verbal podeser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time). Mentalidade - Determinismo >
magia. Você prefere umaregex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável.
- Forensics sobre intuição. Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese.
- Documentação executável. Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. "Documentei em texto" não basta.
- Empatia por agente. Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar. Diferenciais - Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes.
- Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker em integrações com APIs externas instáveis.
- Já trabalhou com monorepos via submodules (nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende os trade-offs.
- Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent frameworks).
- Experiencia com DevOps em servidores Linux dedicados (não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves.
- Familiaridade com conventional commits, semantic-release, gitflow trifásico (feature → homolog → main com cherry-pick).
- Já escreveu post-mortem público / case study técnico que outras pessoas referenciam. Benefícios - VR/VA – Flash Benefícios - Assistência Médica – Bradesco Saúde - Assistência Odontológica – Bradesco - Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4Life - Day Off de Aniversário - TotalPass - Parcerias educacionais (FIAP e Alura)

If you live in Brazil, are fluent in English and want to build a global HR operation from scratch, we're looking for you! About Downtown Engineers Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our work spans from franchise rollouts for brands like McDonald's, Domino's and Dunkin' to hospitality projects with Hilton and Hyatt, healthcare and residential buildings across the United States. We're a remote-first team of 30+ people across different countries, with 300+ projects delivered across 16+ sectors. Our culture is grounded in trust, transparency and autonomy — and that's what we want to nourish with our Human Resources. About the Opportunity You will be Downtown's first HR hire, reporting directly to one of the founding partners, with the mission of building the People function from scratch. Our operation is distributed by design across Brazil, the US and India. We have doubled our team in 2026 (now 30+) and will keep growing at a fast pace, with a People strategic plan already approved by the founders. For the first 12 months, this role will mix orchestration and execution: you will coordinate specialized recruiting agencies in the US, Brazil and India;
manage payroll and benefits;
design and manage development programs in direct partnership with the leadership across the world. One detail defines this role: your main internal clients are in the US and India. Interviews, trainings, sensitive career conversations and negotiations with American vendors will happen in English, every day. Compensation & Structure Full-time contractor (remote, based in Brazil) Fixed monthly compensation Please include your compensation expectation in BRL (R$) in your application What you'll do (major challenges for 2026) A. People Operations across 3 countries Map and stabilize payroll, benefits and employment flows in the US and India Work alongside a BPO in India on hires, payroll calendar, SLAs B. Training & Development Coordinate technical training programs across the US and India Design and coordinate a management development program that allows us to keep growing sustainably C. Recruiting (outsourced execution) Manage specialized recruiting agencies in search for technical positions Build scorecards with hiring managers and document the selection process, preparing the future internalization of recruiting (with new HR hire) Must-haves Fluent English (written and spoken) — a hard requirement. This is not English for occasional meetings: you will run interviews, facilitate trainings, handle sensitive conversations and negotiate with US search firms in English, daily 8-12 years of generalist HR experience Experience at coordinator-to-manager level Strong vendor management skills: BPOs, recruiting agencies, development consultancies Autonomy to operate without a ready-made structure and maturity to work directly with founders Availability to work across time zones: the India window falls in the Brazilian morning, and the US window in the afternoon Nice-to-haves Experience supporting internationally distributed teams Familiarity with the architecture, engineering or construction (AEC) industry Prior experience as a first HR hire or building a People function from scratch Selection Process 1. Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV 2. Screening: English and communication assessment (video)3. Technical challenge 4. Interviews with leadership 5. Offer Why join Downtown? Role with direct business impact Work directly with founders Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy High growth opportunity as the company scales PS: why Brazil? Our CEO is Brazilian and that's where most of our non-technical teams are based.

title: Portuguese Language Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Expert em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for detail-oriented Freelance AI Trainers – Audio to support high-impact Generative AI data annotation projects involving PII identification and content risk assessment on raw audio inputs. In this role, you will listen to and annotate raw audio content to identify personally identifiable information, assess risk signals, evaluate AI-generated outputs where applicable, and apply detailed project guidelines with precision. You will help create high-quality ground truth data used to train and improve advanced AI models. This is a flexible, freelance engagement suited to individuals who want project-based work rather than a fixed weekly schedule. It requires strong listening comprehension, mature judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment where guidelines may evolve frequently. Key Responsibilities As an AI Trainer – Audio, you will: Review and annotate raw audio content, including spoken conversations, calls, and other audio recordings. Identify, classify, and assess personally identifiable information, sensitive data, and privacy-related risks conveyed through audio. Perform risk assessment on audio content involving safety, policy compliance, sensitive topics, and contextual ambiguity. Evaluate AI model outputs derived from audio for correctness, completeness, relevance, risk classification, and guideline adherence, where applicable. Apply complex, frequently updated annotation guidelines consistently and with sound judgment. Handle potentially sensitive, unsafe, or policy-sensitive audio content responsibly and professionally. Manage own schedule and task throughput within agreed project deadlines and quality expectations. Escalate ambiguous cases, guideline gaps, tooling issues, and edge cases to project leads or quality teams. Collaborate remotely with Project Managers, Quality Analysts, and technical teams to improve annotation quality and workflow efficiency. Required Language Proficiency Candidates must demonstrate CEFR C1+ equivalent proficiency in their working language (English or the applicable target language). Bilingual proficiency is not required for this role. Proficiency is required in: Listening / Understanding (primary requirement, given the audio-based nature of the task) Reading comprehension (for guideline interpretation and task instructions) Basic written composition (for annotation notes and escalation of edge cases) The role requires the ability to understand nuanced spoken language, accents, cultural context, idiomatic expressions, policy-sensitive language, and subtle differences in meaning conveyed through audio. Required Experience The ideal candidate should have prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following annotation areas: PII identification or privacy annotation Risk assessment or content safety annotation Audio transcript annotation or audio-based data labeling Named Entity Recognition or entity classification LLM response evaluation AI chatbot evaluation Policy-based content moderation Sensitive content classification Gen AI or LLM training data creation Candidates must have previously worked on annotation projects requiring strict guideline adherence, ambiguity resolution, and quality-focused decision-making. Skills and Competencies We are looking for candidates who have: Excellent listening comprehension and audio interpretation ability in their working language. Strong analytical thinking and decision-making skills. A close attention to detail and consistency. Ability to interpret complex, evolving guidelines and apply them accurately. Comfort working with sensitive, ambiguous, or policy-heavy audio content. Strong understanding of tone, context, and language nuance as conveyed through speech. Ability to work independently in a remote, flexible-hours setup. Familiarity with annotation tools, quality workflows, and productivity tracking. Good communication skills for raising clarifications, documenting edge cases, and collaborating with distributed teams. Qualifications Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent educational qualification preferred. Minimum 1–2 years of relevant annotation experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, audio data, content moderation, PII, risk assessment, or related domains. Prior experience working on Large Language Model training, evaluation, or data annotation projects is strongly preferred. Exposure to audio-based workflows, trust and safety operations, or privacy-focused annotation will be an advantage. Engagement Terms This is a freelance, non-binding engagement — there is no guaranteed or fixed weekly hour commitment on either side. Work volume and availability windows will be communicated on a project/task basis, with flexibility for both iMerit and the freelancer to scale up or down. Compensation is structured on a per-hour basis, aligned to project pricing terms, rather than a fixed salary. Freelancers are expected to maintain agreed quality and turnaround standards for the tasks they accept. What We Offer Flexible, remote freelance opportunity with global project teams. Exposure to cutting-edge Gen AI and LLM data annotation projects. Opportunity to work on meaningful AI safety, privacy, and model improvement initiatives. Structured project guidelines, quality support, and continuous learning opportunities. A collaborative environment focused on precision, accountability, and responsible AI development. Application Note This role is suitable for candidates who are highly analytical, quality-focused, and comfortable working with complex audio annotation guidelines on a flexible, freelance basis. Bilingual proficiency is not required. Prior experience in PII, risk assessment, audio annotation, or LLM evaluation is essential.
