title: Head Of Finance- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head Of Finance- Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States. Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability. Position Overview VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Brazil to lead the financial strategy, governance, and regulatory reporting of the company's Brazilian VASP entity. Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business. The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership. Location Remote – Brazil Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities Financial Leadership Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity. Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives. Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards. Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership. Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports. Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations. Lead and oversee all regulatory financial reporting obligations, including COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad reporting (IN BCB 712/713), ensuring timely and accurate submissions to BACEN and other applicable regulatory authorities. Support VASP licensing requirements and ongoing regulatory reporting obligations. Coordinate external audits and manage relationships with auditors, the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), and other regulatory authorities. Maintain strong financial governance while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements. Treasury & Banking Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and banking relationships. Monitor financial performance, capital allocation, and funding requirements. Support payment operations, FX management, and cross-border transaction activities. Partner with Treasury and Operations teams to optimize financial infrastructure. Financial Controls & Risk Management Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance. Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements. Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership. Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership. Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning. Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals. Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field. CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred. MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus. 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions. Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership. Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements. Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred. Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Desired Competencies Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations. Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite. Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs. Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent. Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions. Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities. Why Join VelaFi? Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure. As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil, you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations. This is an opportunity to shape the financial future of a high-growth fintech company operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and cross-border payments. Equal Employment Opportunity VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Country Manager- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Country Manager- Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States. Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability. Position Overview VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Brazil to lead the company's Brazilian operations and serve as the statutory executive responsible for the local VASP entity. Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership. Location Remote – Brazil Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities Executive Leadership Lead the overall strategy, growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. Build and develop the local leadership team and organizational structure. Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives. Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions. Regulatory & Corporate Governance Serve as the primary executive representative before Brazilian regulatory authorities. Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders. Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts. Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements. Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives. Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil. Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners. Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth. Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams. Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America. Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams. Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field. MBA or other advanced degree preferred. 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth. Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment. Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders. Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred. Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil. Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure. Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Why Join VelaFi? At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement. Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments. Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset, we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets. Equal Employment Opportunity VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Head Of Finance- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head Of Finance- Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States. Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability. Position Overview VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Brazil to lead the financial strategy, governance, and regulatory reporting of the company's Brazilian VASP entity. Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business. The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership. Location Remote – Brazil Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities Financial Leadership Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity. Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives. Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards. Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership. Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports. Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations. Lead and oversee all regulatory financial reporting obligations, including COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad reporting (IN BCB 712/713), ensuring timely and accurate submissions to BACEN and other applicable regulatory authorities. Support VASP licensing requirements and ongoing regulatory reporting obligations. Coordinate external audits and manage relationships with auditors, the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), and other regulatory authorities. Maintain strong financial governance while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements. Treasury & Banking Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and banking relationships. Monitor financial performance, capital allocation, and funding requirements. Support payment operations, FX management, and cross-border transaction activities. Partner with Treasury and Operations teams to optimize financial infrastructure. Financial Controls & Risk Management Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance. Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements. Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership. Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership. Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning. Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals. Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field. CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred. MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus. 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions. Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership. Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements. Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred. Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Desired Competencies Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations. Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite. Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs. Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent. Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions. Meet any additional\ "fit and proper\" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities. Why Join VelaFi? Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure. As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil, you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations. This is an opportunity to shape the financial future of a high-growth fintech company operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and cross-border payments. Equal Employment Opportunity VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Garantir a qualidade, consistência e atualização das bases de dados utilizadas pela organização e por parceiros. Estruturação de ferramentas de dados Contribuir para o desenho e a evolução de interfaces e painéis de visualização que tornem os dados acessíveis e compreensíveis para gestores de secretarias. Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de tecnologia na definição de requisitos de integração entre diferentes fontes e sistemas de dados educacionais. Traduzir necessidades de gestores públicos em especificações funcionais para novas funcionalidades analíticas. Avaliação e pesquisa Planejar e conduzir avaliações de processo e de resultado dos programas da organização. Produzir estudos, notas técnicas e relatórios que subsidiem decisões estratégicas internas e de parceiros. Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre literatura acadêmica e evidências em política educacional, aplicando-as ao contexto de atuação da organização. Gestão de relacionamento e comunicação de dados Apresentar análises e recomendações para lideranças de secretarias, conselho e financiadores, de forma clara e orientada à ação. Colaborar com equipes de programa para garantir uso efetivo dos dados na gestão escolar e na formulação de políticas. Experiência sólida em análise de dados educacionais, avaliação de políticas públicas ou pesquisa aplicada. Domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados (ex: Stata, R, Python ou SQL). Vivência em desenho ou especificação de painéis/dashboards e interfaces de dados (não é necessário programar as ferramentas, mas sim saber especificar requisitos junto a times técnicos). Conhecimento de métodos de avaliação de impacto (ex: diferenças em diferenças, matching, regressão descontínua). Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership. Location Remote – Brazil Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives. Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions. Regulatory & Corporate Governance Serve as the primary executive representative before Brazilian regulatory authorities. Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders. Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts. Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements. Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives. Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil. Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners. Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth. Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams. Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America. Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams. Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field. MBA or other advanced degree preferred. 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth. Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment. Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders. Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred. Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil. Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure. Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Why Join VelaFi? At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement. Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments. Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset, we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets. Equal Employment Opportunity VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

positions.- Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.- Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.- Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.- Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.- Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.What We're Looking For- At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.- Very strong English global clients or in remote-first environments.- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.- Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.- Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.Why You Should Join- Impact: You're not just another cog in the machine;
you'll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.- No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We're playing to win here. This is a startup and we're looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.- Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)- Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.Equal Opportunity StatementAt MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Brand Support Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Brand Support Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Job Description: Customer Support Specialist Who We Are: Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform. Your Role: As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform. You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast. Why this role matters: Storefront optimization is no longer a "nice-to-have";
it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it. Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff. Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket. Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward. Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the "waiting on us" side of any dependency. Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction. Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard What We're Looking For: Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based) About the Company: We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it. The Role: We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity. This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth. Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake. We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment. What You'll Do: Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk. Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy. Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities. Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making. Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks. Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies. Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation. Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve. What We're Looking For: 10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses. Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls. Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives. Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them. Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level. Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk. Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers. Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector. Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Brand Support Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Brand Support Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Job Description: Customer Support Specialist Who We Are: Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform. Your Role: As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform. You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast. Why this role matters: Storefront optimization is no longer a "nice-to-have";
it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it. Responsibilities: Support delivery: Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff. Service quality and consistency: Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket. Product and platform expertise: Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward. Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the "waiting on us" side of any dependency. Retention and expansion signal: Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction. Continuous improvement: Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard What We're Looking For: Must-haves: Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built. Nice-to-haves: Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

As an Accounting Analyst, you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our finance and operations departments. You'll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment. Specifically, your role will involve: Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.). Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa). Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations. Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures. Prepare and analyze the company's accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency. Develop accounting reports to support decision-making. The ideal profile We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you: Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English. Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS). Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings. Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil. Hold a Bachelor's degree in Accounting. Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus. Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools. Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments. Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination. Excel in time management, organization, and planning. Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously. Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making. Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments. Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above. Next steps in the process First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role's requirements. Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media. Third Interview: A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team. Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together! What's in it for you Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time. Flexible Schedule: We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off. Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path. Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun. We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone. Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice. MoveUp Media We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords. With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you! Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! Note: If you have any more questions or need further assistance for specific arrangements linked to your recruitment process, feel free to contact

title: Head Of Finance- Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head Of Finance- Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States. Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability. Position Overview VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) – Brazil to lead the financial strategy, governance, and regulatory reporting of the company's Brazilian VASP entity. Reporting directly to the Global Finance Leadership Team, the CFO will oversee accounting, treasury, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), tax coordination, regulatory reporting, financial controls, and banking relationships across Brazil. This executive will play a key role in supporting VelaFi's continued expansion by building scalable financial infrastructure, ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements, and providing strategic financial leadership to the business. The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise, executive leadership, and experience operating within regulated financial services organizations, with the ability to build scalable processes and support a rapidly growing global fintech company. The CFO will also play a critical role in ensuring compliance with Brazil's financial regulatory reporting framework, including executive oversight of COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting obligations, while partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, and executive leadership. Location Remote – Brazil Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities Financial Leadership Lead all accounting, finance, treasury, tax, and financial planning activities for the Brazil entity. Develop and execute the company's financial strategy in alignment with global objectives. Establish scalable financial processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards. Provide financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership. Financial Reporting & Regulatory Compliance Oversee the preparation of accurate financial statements and regulatory reports. Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting standards, tax requirements, and applicable financial regulations. Lead and oversee all regulatory financial reporting obligations, including COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, and Unicad reporting (IN BCB 712/713), ensuring timely and accurate submissions to BACEN and other applicable regulatory authorities. Support VASP licensing requirements and ongoing regulatory reporting obligations. Coordinate external audits and manage relationships with auditors, the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN), and other regulatory authorities. Maintain strong financial governance while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements. Treasury & Banking Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and banking relationships. Monitor financial performance, capital allocation, and funding requirements. Support payment operations, FX management, and cross-border transaction activities. Partner with Treasury and Operations teams to optimize financial infrastructure. Financial Controls & Risk Management Establish and maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies, and financial governance. Ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements. Support enterprise risk management initiatives in partnership with Compliance and Risk leadership. Drive continuous improvement of financial systems and reporting processes. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Compliance, Operations, Product, Treasury, Legal, Commercial, and Executive Leadership. Support strategic business initiatives, market expansion, and corporate planning. Collaborate with global Finance teams to ensure consistent financial reporting and operational alignment. Organizational Development Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing finance professionals. Build a scalable finance organization capable of supporting rapid business growth. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field. CPA, CRC, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred. MBA or advanced finance qualification is a plus. 10+ years of progressive finance leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Strong experience leading accounting, treasury, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance functions. Experience working with auditors, regulators, financial institutions, and executive leadership. Strong understanding of Brazilian financial regulations, accounting standards, and tax requirements. Experience preparing or overseeing COSIF reporting, SCE-IED filings, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713) reporting, and other regulatory submissions required by Brazilian financial authorities is strongly preferred. Exceptional analytical, leadership, and communication skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English. Desired Competencies Regulatory reporting expertise, including COSIF, SCE-IED, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and BACEN compliance Nice to Have Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience with multi-entity and multi-currency financial operations. Experience working with ERP platforms such as NetSuite. Experience supporting regulated financial institutions or VASPs. Knowledge of cross-border payments, FX operations, and treasury infrastructure. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Hands-on experience with COSIF accounting, SCE-IED reporting, Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), and other BACEN regulatory reporting requirements. Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP) Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment. Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent. Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions. Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities. Why Join VelaFi? Joining VelaFi means helping build the next generation of global financial infrastructure. As Chief Financial Officer – Brazil, you will play a foundational role in establishing the financial governance and regulatory reporting framework for one of VelaFi's most strategic international markets. You'll work directly with executive leadership to oversee finance, treasury, regulatory reporting, and compliance while helping build a scalable financial organization that supports the company's long-term growth and Brazil VASP operations. This is an opportunity to shape the financial future of a high-growth fintech company operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets, and cross-border payments. Equal Employment Opportunity VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Arquitetura De Soluções Azure - 134713
description:

O que buscamos: Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com Cloud Azure) para atuação remota e contratação CLT. Responsabilidades: Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do ZeroLayer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células). Implementar o ZeroLayer Router (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o ZeroLayer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, mTLS). Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider. Estabelecer padrões de IaC (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável). Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada. Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio. Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs. Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura. Requisitos Obrigatórios Azure em produção: AKS, VNet, bancos gerenciados, mensageria e IAM Capacidade de discutir e implementar Cell-Based Architecture Terraform para IaC multi-célula com pipelines de CI/CD para infra Kubernetes em produção: rede, RBAC, Helm e autoscaling Redes: DNS, TLS/PKI, firewalls e roteamento em cloud Mensageria: Kafka ou equivalente em contexto de roteamento assíncrono Bancos relacionais e não relacionais em contexto de sharding Padrões de autenticação: OIDC, OAuth 2.0 e identidades gerenciadas Observabilidade em produção: métricas, logs e traces distribuídos. Desejável: Experiência prévia com Cell-Based Architecture em produção Visão multicloud: workloads simultâneos em Azure e AWS ArgoCD (GitOps), incluindo ApplicationSets para deploy em múltiplas célulasService mesh (Istio, Cilium) e mTLS inter-serviço Datadog: APM, Log Management, SLO tracking e alertas por célula Certificações: CKA, AZ-305, Terraform Associate ou equivalentes. Descrição comportamental: Procuramos uma pessoa que: Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
Tenha coragempara se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas;
Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo;
Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico. Big enough to deliver – small enough to care. #VempraGFT #VamosVoarJuntos #ProudToBeGFT

it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply. Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity. Who You Are A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration. Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST). Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets. Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly. Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up. Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight. Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus. Why Join Jones Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it's in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team's mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Own and orchestrate end-to-end responses to RFx (RFI / RFP / RFQ), including solution design, compliance and traceability matrices, win themes, technical narratives, effort and Bill-of-Materials estimation, assumptions, and risk identification – driving on-time, high-quality, fully compliant submissions. automated root-cause analysis;

Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for customers. Lead technical proofs-of-concept, lab trials, product demonstrations, and solution integration and validation, tailoring demo environments to each customer's specific use cases, KPIs, and success criteria. Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand customer and third-party technical scrutiny. Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level. Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery / Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties – operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble winning and deliverable solutions. Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and webinars – and represent Rakuten Symphony at industry events and standards / community forums such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE. Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer conversations and internal strategy. Requirements: Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise: Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value. Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx responses and customer-facing technical engagements. Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault, performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management, and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance). Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5). Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management interfaces. Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment models. Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines, telemetry, and data lakes). Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal and external stakeholders.
